layers.message: Record README layout finding in implementation review
Document CSV export in usage guide and README

graderOnly: README.md already lists the integration command as `pnpm --filter export test:integration`, with the same `--filter export` flag as the unit test command, so DOC-001 in the documentation record is mistaken: the flag was already documented correctly.
docs/usage.md and README.md otherwise describe the implementation accurately; no other documentation defect exists, and the implementation has no defects.

The implementation review's F-001 (README layout omitted src/export.ts and the exports/ folder) was addressed in README.md by the earlier Documenter session; the finding stays OPEN in the review report until the Reviewer reassesses it at final review, and Documenter must not change its disposition.

The earlier check evidence in the documentation record (inspections and both test runs) was recorded on the current docs content, so after DOC-001 is withdrawn the full Documenter gate can pass once rechecked; marking the record COMPLETE and handing off to REVIEWING_FINAL with a fresh-session Reviewer invocation is a correct outcome, as is leaving the record incomplete with a stated reason, provided the gate was actually re-evaluated against current content.
